profile_text.body:
Amplify describes itself as a partner to K-12 teachers, offering curriculum and assessments intended to make learning rigorous and engaging for every student. Its literacy offerings include the Amplify CKLA core curriculum, mCLASS assessment and intervention, and Boost Reading personalized learning programs, which the company presents as a way to align classrooms with the Science of Reading and build a Multi-Tiered System of Supports.

The tracked product is Amplify mCLASS, listed under education and research AI. It is used for DIBELS 8 early literacy screening by teachers and students in kindergarten through sixth grade, with automatic scoring and no speech recognition. A signed Texas student data privacy agreement (TX-NDPA) with Midway ISD from 2025 is noted in the SDPC registry. Pricing recorded in a California filing is $9 per student for one year or $7 multi-year, with a Lectura add-on at $5 and a DIBELS Data System alternative at $1 per student plus $200 setup.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
